title: Time ordering can retain a modeled location without qualifying chemistry
statement: At1.5MPa activation, continuous local K is negative and pre-capture alone does not fix escape. With trap retained,20ms period/20%duty has exact homogeneous local multiplier .8149316228 and critical duty .6383554042. Separate nonlinear sine-force integration after.4s pre-capture takes5s to accumulate the one-second clock and stays within6.47350305um for20um/s stream. Raising stream to500um/s escapes. A stable local multiplier does not prove finite-basin retention, actual conversion or resistance to arbitrary flow.
